title: 7.4.1 The rate of crime i.e., incidence per lakh of population is a well accepted index to indicate the crime level in a State. Based on this, the crime rate of Crime Against Women in the various States/UTs for the year 1994 is worked out to establish the status position of the State/UT on Crimes Against Women as reported to the Police. RATE OF TOTAL CRIME COMMITTED AGAINST WOMEN DURING 1994 (STATE & UT-WISE)
